rows.label: tlk70000041_03_msg0001
rows.name:
I hear you've been doing a lot lately.
You're making us Iiran soldiers look
bad!

rows.label: tlk70000041_03_msg0002
rows.name: Huh? You mean I'm always slacking off?

rows.label: tlk70000041_03_msg0003
rows.name:
H-hey! Keep it down, OK?
Don't say that out loud...
Someone might hear you.

rows.label: tlk70000041_03_msg0004
rows.name:
My coworkers still haven't found out,
so please be careful what you say!

rows.label: tlk70000041_03_msg0005
rows.name:
What? It's already too late because
the king's son is right here?

rows.label: tlk70000041_03_msg0006
rows.name:
What are you talking... Huh?!
A-Adel-sama?! When did you get there?!

rows.label: tlk70000041_03_msg0007
rows.name:
I'd, um, really appreciate it if
you didn't tell anyone about this.
